title: Identify the historical boundary/treaty
leadin: Each image is a map crop with all labels, legends, place names, and modern borders removed. Identify the line. For 10 points each:

parts.question: This unlabeled Atlantic map shows a north–south line placed west of Africa and east of most of South America. It divided newly claimed overseas lands between two Iberian powers rather than marking a modern national border. Identify this historical boundary or treaty.

This unlabeled map of the Indian subcontinent shows a partition boundary drawn through the northwest and northeast, separating two regions from the main body of the subcontinent. For 10 points, identify this historical boundary or line.

This unlabeled regional map shows a nearly horizontal survey line running westward from the Atlantic coast and stopping near the Appalachian frontier. It became a famous colonial boundary later associated with a cultural divide in American history. Identify this historical boundary or line.
